text:
pete: Heads-up  Sentinel Analytics CISO just escalated and wants an exec bridge today. Blocking items: VPC peering for private-hosted traffic, BYOK for model keys, an explicit EU-only pilot contract clause, and their full security questionnaire (they mentioned SecCheck-5). They also asked for a 6-week POC price and throughput SLA. Who can own what?
anya: I'll grab the VPC peering and networking checklist. Quick note: we require a dedicated peering connection and egress ACLs for pilot clusters. I'll draft the checklist by 2pm PT.
foon: I'll own BYOK/KMS notes. We support customer-managed keys for Dedicated; for hosted pilot we can do key-wrapping with manual rotation logs. I'll write caveats and the proposed manual rotation steps by 3pm.
marta: SE here ; I'll take SLA + perf. They asked for 180 req/s sustained and p99 <= 220ms for chat-gen. I need sanitized payloads to validate. Pete, can you request sample traffic and the exact SecCheck-5 file?
legal-bot: Legal flag: pen-test and SOC2 reports require NDA. Pilot addendum can include EU-region-only processing while pilot is active, but not a permanent residency guarantee. Please file a legal request with subject "Sentinel pen-test" if they want full reports.
pete: I'll request payloads and questionnaire now. Also asking for contact list: CISO (Lena Ho), Head Infra (Marco Silva), and Procurement (Ruth Day).
anya: For peering, note we need a CIDR whitelist and a contact for their network team; also list the expected ports. Will include an ops runbook for establishing peering.
foon: Technical caveat: delegated-admin SCIM for Okta is not supported out-of-the-box. We can offer scoped SCIM (users/groups) or an SE-managed proxy for admin operations during the POC. I'll add both options.
marta: For pricing slide propose two options: 1) metered hosted with 15% pilot discount; 2) reserved pilot cluster (3 nodes) with flat monthly + ops SOW for peering/BYOK. I'll include run-rate to cover autoscale for spikes.
ops-bot: ticket created: SENT-7781 "Sentinel POC: VPC peering + BYOK + EU pilot clause + SLA" Assigned: infra-pilot, se-oncall, legal-queue.
legal-bot: NDA template link: Confluence > NDAs > mutual-pentest-template. Pilot addendum draft will be ready tomorrow morning.
pete: Can we do exec bridge at 15:30 PT? Need SE, infra, and legal to join. I'll invite Lena, Marco, and Ruth.
anya: I can join.
foon: I'll join after 15:00.
marta: I can make it.
pete: Great. I'll drop a one-slide summary (asks + owners + timeline) in this thread by 14:30 PT. Once we get the SecCheck-5 questionnaire and sample payloads, Marta will run a perf window in eu-west-1.
anya: Also note: if packet capture or network-level pen-test is requested we must coordinate with eng-telemetry and get a signed SOW.
pete: Thanks team. Posting updates here as they arrive. :white_check_mark:
